invariants.text: every registry object id is unique within its collection
declared unique keys are unique
slug unique among non-closed workspaces
every internal reference resolves
at most one active primary link per workspace; exactly one for provisioning/active/degraded/suspended/closing workspaces
a company referenced by a workspace-scoped object is actively linked to that workspace; a company has an active primary link in at most one workspace; audit workspace matches target workspace
immutable fields are never changed by a mutation
registry records are archived or retired, never deleted
every registry object has at least one audit event targeting it
audit events are never updated or deleted
one idempotency scope key never carries different request content
a repeated trigger with the same idempotency scope key yields exactly one resulting object
a closed workspace has no provisioning job created after closure unless explicitly reactivated with audit
an ERP instance beyond draft requires an active primary link whose company equals the instance company
shared instances have no workspace; isolated instances have one; isolation allowed by the application definition
no two non-retired instances for the same workspace and application
provider_environment_id unique among isolated instances
suspension or closure keeps links, subscriptions and audit history
no raw secret values; credential_reference is a reference only
every SubscriptionReference carries provenance with an audit event; manual_beta requires manual_registration
unknown entitlement or bundle code is rejected (fail-closed)
provisioning jobs and provisioning entitlements reference a declared handler
manual_admin_grant and support_override carry a reason
an effective entitlement has all dependencies effective
the Moodle cloudmap projection agrees with the registry via WorkspaceCompanyLink and the status mapping
a Moodle snapshot contains exactly the effective mgmt.* codes of its workspace

clarifications.detail: REG-001 §60 uses 'Not Provisioned' for ERP instances, REG-002 §14 enum has no such value. v0.1 uses 'draft' for a registered but not provisioned instance and maps it to cloudmap 'not_provisioned'. Needs REG v0.2 decision.
REG-002 §9 describes mgmt/academy only as shared. OD-1 requires isolated spaces as an option, so v0.1 allows isolation=isolated for mgmt. Needs REG v0.2 confirmation.
company_link.status, subscription commercial_status and audit actor_type are named in REG-001 without values; v0.1 values are authored and marked in enum_provenance.
OD-8 allows manual registration with audit and provenance; commercial_provider 'manual_beta' and provenance.source_type are authored v0.1 values.
MIG-001 §6 (Requested..Closed) and ENT-001 §5 (Pending..Revoked) differ. v0.1 keeps ENT-001 states for assignments and ApplicationInstance states for operations (ENT-001 §26).
REG-001 §3 names CloudCustomer.status without values; v0.1 accepts any non-empty string.
Hire product and hire.* codes remain OPEN (OD-6); no canonical code is assigned.
